feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
entry.summary: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

entry.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's stronghold
entry.summary: Pakistan has imposed emergency rule in the province governed by the political party of imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan.

entry.title: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
entry.summary: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.

entry.title: Win or lose, independent candidates want to meet voters in the middle
entry.summary: Nearly 200 independent candidates in more than 100 congressional races are trying to prove there's an alternative to the two party system — even though the chance of winning is very low.

entry.title: One way to protect coral reefs? Bring back seabirds
entry.summary: Coral reefs are facing increasing threats around the globe. But on a remote Pacific island, scientists have found that reefs can get help from a surprising ally: seabirds.

entry.title: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
entry.summary: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.

entry.title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
entry.summary: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump will headline a rally in Alaska Tuesday, federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home Monday, Trump's diesel deal with Russia frustrates European leaders.

entry.title: USA prepares for Women's World Cup with matches against top team Spain
entry.summary: With less than a year until the FIFA Women's World Cup kicks off in Brazil, the U.S. women's national soccer team is testing its mettle with two friendlies against the world's top team, Spain.

entry.title: DNA and vehicle-tracking help French investigators recover stolen Renoirs
entry.summary: DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.
